summary: Iteration 2 testing of P1 features (Tax Invoices, Meet Planner, Petty Cash, Outstanding, Attendance w/ geofencing, Office Settings, mobile responsive sidebar). 15/15 new backend pytest tests pass. Legacy 23/23 tests still valid. Frontend: all 5 new nav sections show under Sales CRM / Work / Finance for admin. Invoice modal computes CGST/SGST correctly (₹1,00,000 subtotal → ₹9,000 + ₹9,000 → ₹1,18,000 total). Meet Planner weekly grid renders 84 slots (7 days × 12 hours 08:00–19:00), slot click opens Schedule modal. Petty Cash KPIs + Balance column ok. Outstanding shows all 4 aging buckets + 3 tables. Attendance page renders gracefully when geolocation is denied. Office & Geofence settings persist after reload (radius 275 → confirmed after refresh). Raghu login correctly hides Role Manager, shows 'No access' for /admin/roles, and sees all new pages (invoices/meets/attendance/petty-cash/outstanding). Mobile 375×812: sidebar hidden off-screen (x=-260) by default — drawer behavior works. Iteration 1 dashboard 'nan' bar is fixed (monthly_revenue filtered).

minor.issue: `duration_min` is always 0 because server.py check_out uses `_dt.now(timezone.utc)` but `timezone` is not imported at the top of server.py. NameError is silently swallowed by the try/except → duration=0. FIX: add `from datetime import timezone` at the top of /app/backend/server.py (or use `_dt.now(_dt.now().astimezone().tzinfo)` / drop timezone kwarg since fromisoformat now returns tz-aware datetime).

ui_bugs.issue: React console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique "key" prop.' Caused by using <>...</> fragments inside a .map() in the grid. Replace fragments with a keyed wrapper element or use React.Fragment with a key.

The row-level printer icon (line 155) has no data-testid. Only the button inside the print preview has data-testid='quote-print-btn'. Spec lists quote-print-btn as the row action — add data-testid to the row printer icon for automation (e.g., `q-print-{id}`), or move the existing testid to the row icon.

action_items: Add `from datetime import timezone` (or import at top) in /app/backend/server.py so attendance check-out computes duration_min correctly.
Fix Meets.jsx list-key React warning (replace bare <> with keyed React.Fragment inside .map()).
Add data-testid to the Quotes row printer icon (currently untestable via testid — must query by title='Print').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py check_out silently swallows all exceptions and returns duration_min=0 — masking the timezone NameError. Prefer narrower except or let it propagate so bugs are visible.
make_crud PUT still accepts a raw dict — new invoice/meet/petty-cash endpoints inherit this lack of Pydantic validation on updates. Fine for MVP.

seed_all runs unconditionally on startup — check if it's idempotent for the new collections (invoices/meets/petty_cash), else counts will keep growing across restarts. Backend tests currently only assert >= seed thresholds, so growth would not be detected.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject in production; ensure CORS_ORIGINS env is set in prod.
Meets.jsx grid uses <> fragments → key-prop warning. Small but pollutes console.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all major flows work; 2 low-priority polish items)

Attendance tests may skip if admin/raghu already checked-in today — this is expected behavior. The check-out `duration_min` bug is minor (silent NameError → 0). Meets.jsx list-key warning is cosmetic. Everything else works end-to-end including mobile drawer and RBAC for the new pages.
rca_of_the_issue: duration_min=0 bug — server.py line 324 references `timezone.utc` but only imports `date`, `datetime as _dt`, `timedelta` inside functions; `timezone` was never imported. The `try/except Exception` wrapping the datetime math catches the NameError and falls through to `duration = 0`, so the endpoint returns 200 with duration_min=0 instead of the real elapsed minutes.
